critical_code_review_comments: OshaInspectionGuideRequest model uses EmailStr (good) but first_name and company default to '' — backend route already handles None via `(request.first_name or '').strip()`. Defensive and clean.

Vince notification email injects user-supplied first_name/company directly into HTML without escaping (routes/osha_inspection_guide.py lines 56-63). Low severity (Vince sees own internal email), but consider html.escape() to prevent HTML injection if this email ever feeds another system.

Backend route writes 2 separate Mongo inserts (osha_inspection_guide_leads + download_events) before fire-and-forget MailerLite. Each submit creates 2 rows — fine for now but worth noting for analytics dedup.

Frontend OshaInspectionGuidePage uses fetch directly with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Error state renders 'oig-error' element with mailto fallback — solid UX. No retry handler, but acceptable for a one-shot lead-magnet form.
